items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: and finally Betty Roche started dropping in and so she became our vocalist.

ctx.x: go over and just take over the job and jam all night long, you know.

So they would always try to get me to come to New York, you know, to -- so finally when I did go there we just got together right away. You know, as a matter of fact he had just left Basie, and we just took up where we left off in Chicago. And we played every day. We would go downstairs in the hotel, in the Woodside Hotel, and play every day, as I told you, without piano.
